reports.title: McKESSON REPORTS FISCAL 2027 SECOND QUARTER RESULTS

guidance.heading: Fiscal 2027 Full Year Outlook
section: •Raised Adjusted Earnings per Diluted Share guidance range to $45.60 to $46.40, from the previous range of $44.20 to $45.00.
•Fiscal 2027 Adjusted Earnings per Diluted Share guidance range indicates 17% to 19% growth compared to the prior year.
•The Company does not forecast GAAP earnings per diluted share1.

“McKesson delivered another quarter of strong results, reflecting operational strength in our core business segments and disciplined execution across the enterprise,” said Brian Tyler, chair and chief executive officer. “We continue to invest strategically to advance healthcare outcomes and create long-term value. We further strengthened our portfolio through transactions that will expand our capabilities and deepen our presence in key growth areas, while maintaining our commitment to financial discipline. We are confident in our ability to leverage differentiated solutions and create value for customers, partners, patients, and shareholders. As we close out a strong first half of our fiscal year, I want to thank Team McKesson for their unwavering commitment to excellence and for the impact they make across healthcare every day.”

desk.headline: Revenue up 8% to $111.0bn and adjusted EPS up 18% to $11.68, beat; full-year adjusted EPS guidance raised to $45.60–46.40

other.label: Prescription Technology Solutions adj. operating profit

results: Revenue grew 8% to $111.0bn on higher prescription volumes and specialty drug distribution, partly offset by lower branded-drug contributions.
Adjusted EPS rose 18% to $11.68 (GAAP $10.44, up from $8.92), helped by a 6% lower share count.
Core drug distribution adjusted profit rose 22% to $1.0bn; Oncology & Multispecialty sales jumped 24% to $15.0bn with adjusted profit up 8% to $427m.
Medical-Surgical was the soft spot: adjusted profit fell 10% to $225m on ambulatory product mix.
Quarterly free cash flow was $2.9bn; in the first half $3.4bn went to buybacks and $198m to dividends. Quarterly dividend is $0.94, up from $0.82.

guidance.summary: McKesson raised its fiscal 2027 (year to March 2027) adjusted EPS range to $45.60–46.40 from $44.20–45.00, or 17–19% growth. It does not forecast GAAP EPS. The new midpoint sits above the analyst consensus cited in coverage.

points: GLP-1 weight-loss drug distribution revenue reached about $16bn, up 26% y/y; management said demand stays strong but varies quarter to quarter.
Segment outlooks were set for the year: core distribution profit growth of 14–18% and Oncology & Multispecialty profit growth of 18–22%; Medical-Surgical profit seen flat to down 4%.
The roughly $2.25bn Precision Medicine Group deal closed and is expected to add $0.10–0.20 to this year's adjusted EPS, mostly in Q4; the Option Care stake is not in guidance.
The company plans about $5bn of buybacks this year and free cash flow of roughly $4.5–4.9bn.
Management flagged faster spending on automation and technology in the second half and uncertainty around a possible January 2027 340B rebate model.
